text: What type of industrial maintenance or assembly application are you performing?

options.label: Locking threaded fasteners (bolts, nuts, studs, screws)
Sealing threaded pipe fittings or hydraulic/pneumatic connectors
Sealing mating flanges or carter covers (gasketing)
Retaining cylindrical joints (bearings, shafts, keyways, bushings)
Pump rebuilding, wear protection, or chemical coating
Structural bonding of metals, magnets, or plastics

text: What is the fastener size and required disassembly level?

options.label: Small screws (< M6) — requires easy hand tool disassembly
Standard bolts/nuts (M6 to M20) — removable with standard hand tools
Standard bolts/nuts (M6 to M20) — Health & Safety green formula (no hazard label)
Permanent high-strength stud/bolt locking (M10 to M20)
Large studs/bolts (> 1 inch / > M20) — heavy duty permanent
Fastener is ALREADY assembled and tightened

text: What is the thread type, pipe material, and requirement?

options.label: Fine threads, hydraulic or pneumatic connectors (zero contamination)
Coarse metal pipe threads (general purpose medium strength)
Stainless steel or high temp metal fittings
Immediate pressure, potable water, gas, or plastic/metal threads

text: What is the flange material and gap size?

options.label: Rigid cast iron/steel/aluminum flange (gap <= 0.25 mm)
Rigid metal flange with high temperature (up to 204°C)
Stamped sheet metal or flexible flange (gap up to 3 mm)
Rigid flange with Health & Safety eco-formulation (no hazard label)

text: What is the fit type and radial clearance/gap size on the shaft or housing?

options.label: Press fit assembly (very small gap)
Slip fit with tight clearance (gap <= 0.15 mm / 0.006 in)
Slip fit with standard clearance (gap <= 0.25 mm / 0.010 in)
Worn shaft, wallowed keyway, or large gap (gap 0.25 mm to 0.50 mm)
Badly worn shaft requiring metal rebuild and lathe machining

text: What specific pump maintenance problem are you addressing?

options.label: Internal volute/casing rebuild due to heavy erosion/cavitation
Impeller & volute low-friction ceramic topcoating
External or internal severe chemical / sulfuric acid protection
Worn shaft rebuilding at bearing seat or gland packing
Anti-seize protection for casing studs and gland nuts
